prompts.title: Beautiful Radha Portrait with Floral Jewelry and Flute
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
Create a photorealistic cinematic portrait of a beautiful woman dressed as a graceful divine-inspired Indian flute musician, centered in a vertical composition. She has smooth, glowing skin, subtle makeup, and a slight natural blush on her cheeks, voluminous smooth hair flowing naturally over her shoulders, adorned with delicate floral hair jewelry and a single elegant peacock feather. The subject is dressed in a traditional pastel blue lehenga set adorned with intricate gold embroidery—the blouse richly detailed with fine gold patterns, paired with a flowing matching skirt and a sheer dupatta draped elegantly over the arms. Delicate white-and-pink floral jewelry decorates her neck, wrists, upper arm, and ears. Elegant white traditional face art is painted across her forehead and around her eyes. She gently holds a polished wooden bansuri flute diagonally across her chest with both hands, standing with her body slightly angled while looking directly into the camera with a soft, and graceful smile.
Background: dreamy studio backdrop with a smooth cyan-blue glow on the left transitioning into warm peach-pink on the right, subtle atmospheric haze and soft bokeh.
Lighting: Cinematic soft beauty lighting, a slightly warm rim light from the right, gentle highlights on the hair and skin, and natural skin tones.
Composition: medium-to-three-quarter portrait, subject centered, flute clearly visible, flowing hair creating elegant framing, shallow depth of field.
Camera: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, soft background separation, high dynamic range, cinematic color grading, ultra-detailed skin and fabric textures, photorealistic, 8K resolution, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.
Negative prompt: distorted hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, bad anatomy, deformed face, unnatural eyes, plastic skin, duplicate objects, blurry subject, identity change.

prompts.title: Kintsugi Soul
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic cinematic digital portrait using the attached reference image as the exact facial identity.

⚠️ Face match is mandatory — the facial structure, proportions, skin details, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, beard shape, and overall likeness must remain 100% identical to the reference face.

Do not beautify, stylize, or alter the face shape. Only apply artistic effects to materials, lighting, and surface texture.
Subject & Physical Appearance
The subject is a muscular adult male with a powerful, bodybuilder-level physique.
Highly defined anatomy: broad chest, sculpted pectorals, sharply carved abdominals, thick deltoids, strong biceps, and visible muscle striations.
Pose is frontal and symmetrical, shoulders squared, chest forward, commanding presence.
Facial features remain exactly the same as the reference image:

Same head shape and proportions
Same eye spacing, gaze direction, eyelids
Same(well maintained) beard density, mustache shape, and hairline
Stoic and intense expression, calm yet powerful gaze locked forward, eyes sharp and focused, lips relaxed but firm, conveying resilience, confidence, and quiet dominance.
Skin Texture & Material (Face-Safe)
Preserve realistic human skin details on the face: visible pores, micro-wrinkles, and natural texture.
The overall body surface appears matte black, resembling obsidian, charcoal, or dark volcanic stone.
The face retains its exact human structure and identity while adopting the same matte black stone material — no loss of realism.
No plastic look, no over-smoothing, no stylization.
Kintsugi Gold Fracture Effect
The body appears fractured and repaired using Kintsugi-style molten gold inlays.
Jagged cracks run organically across the body and face, following natural anatomy.
Gold Crack Placement (Do Not Obscure Face Identity):
Face

One controlled vertical crack down the forehead and bridge of the nose
Secondary cracks along the cheek and temple
Cracks follow facial topology and never distort facial structure
Chest / Heart

Heavy gold concentration over the subject’s left pectoral (viewer’s right)
Thick, rugged gold patch resembling a healed wound or glowing core
Torso

Gold veins tracing the sternum and abdominal separations
Arms & Shoulders

Gold fractures wrapping around deltoids, biceps, and forearms, emphasizing muscle contours
Gold appears like solidified molten metal — textured, imperfect, reflective, and luminous.
Lighting, Color Tone & Thunderstorm Atmosphere
Overall color tone:

Dominantly deep matte black with rich, warm gold highlights
High contrast between dark stone skin and glowing gold veins
No color pollution — strictly black and gold palette
Primary lighting:

Low-key cinematic chiaroscuro lighting
Soft, controlled highlights on:
Forehead
Cheekbones
Upper chest
Shoulders and collarbones
Gold illumination:

Gold fractures emit warm amber-gold light
Subtle glow bleeding softly onto nearby skin and muscle contours
Background & Thunderstorm Effect:

Background remains a deep black void
Faint golden thunderstorm lightning flashes subtly visible behind the subject
Lightning is abstract, diffused, and atmospheric — not literal bolts
Occasional soft golden backlight pulses as if distant thunder is illuminating the scene
Rim lighting:

Thin golden rim light outlining shoulders, arms, and upper torso
Enhances silhouette separation without overpowering the face
No harsh shadows crossing facial features. Face clarity and identity remain untouched.
Rendering & Quality
Ultra-high resolution

Hyper-realistic anatomy and face blending

Studio-grade cinematic lighting

Sharp focus, dramatic contrast

No text, no logos, no background elements, no face swap look
